Subject: Re: [UAI] Belief Propagation Software

Hi,

I recently released a free/open source software library called libDAI
that supports various approximate inference algorithms (amongst which
loopy BP) on arbitrary factor graphs with discrete variables. It is a
C++ library and offers a simple command line interface and a MatLab
interface (currently disabled because of compilation problems for some
MatLab versions, but this is a minor issue).

Documentation still has to be written but I'll try to offer some support
by email in the meantime.

Neighborhoods larger than 4 are supported.

For more information, see http://www.mbfys.ru.nl/~jorism/libDAI
(where the package can be downloaded).

Regards,

Joris Mooij
Radboud University Nijmegen, The Netherlands
